text: You see Mrs. Stapleton, the librarian.

text: You see a middle-aged woman.

text: Hi, Welcome to the Library.  I don't think I have seen you around these parts before.   What might you be looking for in the way of knowledge?
source_text:
Hi, Welcome to the Library.  I don't think I have seen you around these parts
 before.   What might you be looking for in the way of knowledge?

text: Good to see you again.  What might you be looking for today?
source_text: Good to see you again.  What might you be looking for today?

text: What do you have in the way of books?
source_text: What do you have in the way of books?

text: I am looking for a Water Chip.
source_text: I am looking for a Water Chip.

text: Nothing, but thanks.

text: Well, let me show you my selection.

text: Well, in my studies I have come across some references to such things.  Actually I have in my posession a Holodisk that contains a certain amount of information that you might find useful.
source_text:
Well, in my studies I have come across some references to such things.  Actually
 I have in my posession a Holodisk that contains a certain amount of information that you
 might find useful.

text: A Holodisk, what is that?
source_text: A Holodisk, what is that?

text: Can I have the Holodisk?
source_text: Can I have the Holodisk?

text: A Holodisk contains information on it, but it can only be read by a certain number of electronic devices.  I see that you have a PIP Boy. You can use that to decode, review, and store the information that a Holodisk contains.
source_text:
A Holodisk contains information on it, but it can only be read by a certain number

 and store the information that a Holodisk contains.

text: Sounds great! Can I have the Holodisk?
source_text: Sounds great! Can I have the Holodisk?

text: Information is hard to come by in this day and age.  I will need to charge you 750 Hub Bucks for the disk.
source_text:
Information is hard to come by in this day and age.  I will need to charge you 750

text: Sounds good. Here's the money.
source_text: Sounds good. Here's the money.

text: Now that looks like a worn Holodisk if I've ever seen one.  I'll give you 500 for it.
source_text:
Now that looks like a worn Holodisk if I've ever seen one.  I'll give you 500 for
 it.

text: How about I take a blowtorch to this whole place instead! Huh lady?!
source_text: How about I take a blowtorch to this whole place instead! Huh lady?!

text: Sorry, don't have the cash.
source_text: Sorry, don't have the cash.

text: I am sorry but I can only accept the full amount for the Holodisk.  Please return when you have that amount.
source_text:
I am sorry but I can only accept the full amount for the Holodisk.  Please return

text: I am sorry, but you wil need to keep your pyromaniacal tendencies to yourself. Please leave.
source_text:
I am sorry, but you wil need to keep your pyromaniacal tendencies to yourself.
 Please leave.

text: [Mrs Stapleton takes your money.]
source_text: [Mrs Stapleton takes your money.]

text: You are right, the Disk has seen better days.  Since that is the case, I will accept 500 instead of my original price. [Mrs Stapleton takes your money.]
source_text:
You are right, the Disk has seen better days.  Since that is the case, I will

text: Normally, I do not give in to such methods, but to protect my collection from such a threat I will give you the Disk.  In exchange, I would ask that you never return here.
source_text:
Normally, I do not give in to such methods, but to protect my collection from such

text: As I may have explained, you will need to use this and then access the information through your PIP Boy.  [Mrs. Stapleton hands you the Holodisk]

text: You will have to excuse me, but I have research to do.
